name: io.github.NexTools-Solutions/mcp-glpi
title: NexTool MCP for GLPI
description: MCP server for GLPI: tickets, ITIL, assets, knowledge base. GLPI 10/11. Not affiliated with Teclib'.

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_URL
environmentVariables.description: GLPI instance URL for the API v1 tools (apirest.php or api.php/v1)

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_USER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: GLPI API User Token (API v1 tools)

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_APP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: GLPI API Application Token

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_V2_URL
environmentVariables.description: GLPI 11 URL for the API v2 tools (glpi_v2_*)

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_V2_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 client ID (API v2)

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_V2_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 client secret (API v2)

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_V2_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: GLPI user for the OAuth2 password grant (API v2)

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_V2_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password of that user (API v2)

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_V2_SCOPE
environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 scope (default api)

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_V2_API_VERSION
environmentVariables.description: API version path, e.g. v2.2 (default v2)

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Named tool presets, comma-separated: core, tickets, itil, assets, kb, documents, users, search, admin, v2

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_TOOLS_INCLUDE
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated globs: register matching tools (adds to GLPI_TOOLSETS; with neither set, every tool registers)

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_TOOLS_EXCLUDE
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated globs: drop matching tools

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Block every write and destructive tool (default false)

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_ALLOW_DELETE
environmentVariables.description: Enable destructive tools (default false)

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_REQUIRE_DELETE_REASON
environmentVariables.description: Require a reason on destructive tools (default true)

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE
environmentVariables.description: Items returned when no range is given (default 25)

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_MAX_PAGE_SIZE
environmentVariables.description: Hard ceiling of items per call (default 200)

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_IDEMPOTENCY_WINDOW
environmentVariables.description: Seconds an identical create is replayed instead of repeated (default 120, 0 disables)

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_RESOURCE_CACHE_TTL
environmentVariables.description: Resource cache TTL in ms (default 300000)

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Max retry attempts on 429/5xx (default 3)

environmentVariables.name: GLPI_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Request timeout in ms (default 30000)
